allow: PowerShell($n = \(Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\); if \($n\) { "node: " + \(node --version\) } else { "node: NOT INSTALLED" }; $p = \(Get-Command npm -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\); if \($p\) { "npm: " + \(npm --version\) } else { "npm: NOT INSTALLED" }; $g = \(Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\); if \($g\) { "git: " + \(git --version\) } else { "git: NOT INSTALLED" })
PowerShell(foreach \($c in @\('python','py','python3'\)\) { $x = Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($x\) { "$c -> $\($x.Source\)" } else { "$c -> not found" } })

PowerShell($w = Get-Command winget -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($w\) { "winget available" } else { "winget not found" }; Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name)
